subject: Urgent: Temperature-sensitive demo units delayed at CFS - need expedited clearance and temp docs
messages:
From: Marco Reyes <marco@stellarbooths.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Shipping update for Booth A12 - deconsolidated at CFS

Hi Priyom,

Quick update from our carrier: the shipment for Booth A12 (4 crates, demo tablets + chargers) was deconsolidated at the CFS yesterday and flagged by customs for a battery declaration. The tablets have internal lithium-ion cells and the carrier's CFS team is holding the crates pending the declaration and a short physical inspection.

We are attaching the packing list and the temperature log for the last 48 hours (the tablets are configured for a live demo and should not exceed 30C). We left a 4-hr spike in the temp log during transfer — I don't think the units are damaged but we need the release to reach the advance warehouse before the 02/14 cutoff.

Attachments: packing_list_stellar_A12.pdf, temp_log_20260209.csv

Can BlueHarbor/Maritime help expedite the clearance? If we can't get a same-day release we'll miss the warehouse ETA and will have to ship to a local bonded site with extra drayage (big penalty for the show).

Apologies for the late notice — carrier updated us this morning.

Thanks,
Marco Reyes
Operations Manager | Stellar Booths
marco@stellarbooths.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marco Reyes <marco@stellarbooths.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, BlueHarbor Logistics <ops@blueharborlogistics.com>, Amy Lin <amy@maritimecb.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Temperature-sensitive demo units delayed at CFS - need expedited clearance and temp docs

Marco — thanks for the heads up and for the files. Copying Hannah (logistics) and Laura (field ops) to align on next steps.

A few immediate asks so we can move fast:
- Marco / Stellar: please confirm the airway bill / bill of lading numbers and the CFS reference (we need MBL/MAWB or HBL).
- Please attach a signed battery declaration for the tablets (UN/DOT paperwork) — customs asked specifically for battery paperwork. If you have a manufacturer statement of compliance that helps.
- BlueHarbor / Amy, can you confirm whether the carrier can apply for a bonded temporary release to move to our advance warehouse under bond? If bonded release isn't available, confirm fees and ETA for transfer to a bonded yard + drayage.

Operational constraints: the advance warehouse cutoff is 23:59 PT on 2026-02-14. If we don't have clear release paperwork and carrier confirmation by end of day 02/12 we will incur same-day re-routing charges and likely miss the consolidated pickup. Please escalate the clearance and advise fee estimate; procurement will need sign-off for expedite charges.

I'll authorize up to $1,200 in ad-hoc expedite fees today if needed; anything beyond that needs Laura approval.

Next: Marco, share MAWB/MBL and battery declaration. BlueHarbor / Amy — confirm bonded option and estimated pickup window.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sr. Field Marketing Program Manager | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0103
From: Ops Team <ops@blueharborlogistics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marco Reyes <marco@stellarbooths.com>
Cc: Amy Lin <amy@maritimecb.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 07:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Temperature-sensitive demo units delayed at CFS - bonded release options

Hi Priyom / Marco — BlueHarbor ops here.

Thanks for the flag. We pulled the MBL/MAWB: MBL 987-SEA-21 / MAWB 241-555-9072. CFS ref: CFS-SFO-4471. The shipment is currently in the CFS hold queue — customs has requested a formal battery declaration (we've attached the carrier release template and a quick form of what customs wants).

Options:
1) Apply for bonded temporary release to Redwood's advance warehouse under bond (we can move under carrier bond; requires signed release form and battery declaration). Estimated timeline: 18-24 hours after documents submitted. Estimated expedite fee: $950 - covers lift, bonded movement, and CFS handling.
2) Full customs clearance (formal entry) — will take 48-72 hours and may require sample inspection. Fees will be higher (estimated $1,800+) and risk missing warehouse cutoff.

We recommend option 1 to preserve the temperature window and meet your 02/14 ADV warehouse deadline. We'll need: signed release_letter_template.pdf (attached), signed battery_declaration_signed.pdf, and acknowlegement from Redwood to proceed with expedite fee. Please confirm and we'll file immediately.

Attachment: release_letter_template.pdf

Regards,
BlueHarbor Ops | BlueHarbor Logistics
ops@blueharborlogistics.com | +1 415-555-0230
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ops Team <ops@blueharborlogistics.com>, Marco Reyes <marco@stellarbooths.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Amy Lin <amy@maritimecb.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: Temperature-sensitive demo units delayed at CFS - proceed with bonded movement

BlueHarbor / Marco — confirmed. Proceed with option 1 (bonded temporary release to Redwood advance warehouse).

Laura: please approve up to $1,200 for expedite/bonded handling — BlueHarbor estimates $950; I'm authorizing up to $1,200 to cover any surcharges. If the final cost exceeds that, loop me before payment.

Marco: please send the signed battery declaration and sign the release_letter_template.pdf and upload to the drive link below so BlueHarbor can file. Marco / Stellar: we also need proof of insurance coverage for the shipment during bonded movement.

BlueHarbor: once filed please confirm ETA for pickup and provide a pickup window we can share with the ADV warehouse. Also confirm who will handle temperature monitoring in transit (carrier to provide).

I'll create JIRA EVENTS-478 for logistics tracking and tag ops.

Drive folder for docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_event_ship_docs
DocuSign (release): https://docusign.net/US/1234-evt-release

Thanks — Priyom
